Movilidad/Tech.descripcion: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) is partnering with TripleLift to extend Uber Advertising audiences beyond Uber's own apps. The new offsite audience expansion product uses Uber's first party mobility and delivery data to target users across the open web. This collaboration marks Uber Advertising's first effort to monetize its data as an external media targeting layer for advertisers. Consumo Defensivo.titulo: Costco (COST) Stock Looks Expensive Despite Strong Sales Growth
Consumo Defensivo.descripcion: Costco Wholesale has ridden a powerful multi year run and now trades near US$989 a share, which puts a spotlight on one basic question: Are you paying a sensible price for Costco’s earnings at today’s level, or has the stock moved beyond what its profit stream can reasonably justify? Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 113.0%, which puts a lot of long term optimism into the current valuation debate around its earnings power.
